description.value: Mid Island Liquor - Duncan is a branch of Mid Island Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative operating 18 liquor store locations across Vancouver Island and surrounding Gulf Islands communities. As part of a member-owned co-op, the Duncan location contributes to a regional network rooted in community ownership rather than corporate franchising. Cyclists travelling through the Cowichan Valley can stop here to resupply with beer, wine, or spirits from a well-established local institution.
